senses.gloss: dālana (nt.; Skt. in diff. mg.; = AMg. ˚ṇa), splitting, piercing; in literal sense, of a military art mastered by the Bodhisattva: (bhedye) dālane sphālane … LV 〔156.13〕 (Tib. dbug pa); fig., object heresies: sarva-dṛṣṭigata-jāladālanāya prayuktaḥ Gv 〔117.3〕; adj. (perh. Bhvr.?) destroying (heresies): (mahāyogināṃ …) akuśala-dṛṣṭidālanānāṃ Laṅk 〔10.13〕.
dālāvana (if not corruption), some sort of tree: (panasa-)dālāvana-tinduka- etc. Divy 〔627.23〕 (in long cpd. containing list of trees).
